san3.navigation.requiresStrategy: Capture again at the strategic map.
san3.navigation.requiresCreation: Capture again during new officer registration.
san3.navigation.requiresReserves: This capture has no valid city reserve roster.
san3.unavailable.relationships: City and officer relationships could not be verified. Capture again at the strategic map.
san3.unavailable.neutralCity: Only used when claiming a neutral city with a valid officer roster.
san3.unavailable.shipbuilding: Requires a player-controlled port with serving officers, direct administration and valid ship stocks.
san3.unavailable.inventory: The global treasure inventory could not be verified. Capture again before changing book copies.
san3.unavailable.tasks: Requires an eligible serving officer and a consistent task group in the city.
san3.unavailable.joining: Requires an idle officer and an eligible shared task group in the same city.
san3.unavailable.infiltration: No covert operation is eligible for this officer. Check role, assignment, covert status and the other active factions.
san3.unavailable.appearance: Requires a registered ordinary custom officer and automatic appearance enabled in a valid scenario. Rulers, governors, busy officers and officers carrying equipment or treasures cannot be rescheduled.
san3.unavailable.activeFaction: Select an active faction with a ruler.
san3.unavailable.turnOrder: This capture has no valid monthly turn queue. Capture again at the strategic map.
san3.unavailable.unusedFaction: Select an unused faction slot to found a new faction.
san3.unavailable.diplomacy: Requires the selected faction and at least one other faction to be active.
